**Allient Inc. to Present Advanced Motion Technologies at SPS 2026**


[Download printer-friendly version](https://allient.com/d/?h=4e06c56)


**Buffalo, N.Y. – 23 November, 2026 –** Allient Inc. (Nasdaq: ALNT) (“Allient” or the “Company”), a global designer and manufacturer of advanced specialty motor, Motion, Controls, and Power products and solutions for targeted industries and applications, has today announced it will showcase its advanced motion technologies at SPS (Smart Production Solutions) 2026, taking place November 24–26 at the NürnbergMesse in Nuremberg, Germany.


If you are attending, please stop by Hall 1, Booth #241 and #340 to explore Allient’s technologies, or[get in touch](https://allient.com/contact-us/) to arrange a meeting during the event.


At SPS 2026, Allient will feature the new KinetiMax™ Housed HPD Series, within the Allied Motion line. The motor combines proven KinetiMax™ Frameless HPD technology with an integrated housing, shaft, and bearing package to deliver a complete motor solution with exceptional torque density and simplified integration.


Technologies and solutions from Allient’s Allied Motion and Heidrive product lines on display at SPS will include:


- KinetiMax™ Precision Series: Compact, high-performance motors designed for precision motion control applications requiring accuracy, reliability, and design flexibility.
- KinetiMax™ Frameless HPD Series: High power density, outer-rotor design brushless motors featuring frameless part sets.
- KinetiMax™ Housed HPD Series: Complete motor solution with an integrated housing, shaft, and bearing package for exceptional torque density and simplified integration.
- HeiTronX Servo Motors with Integrated Electronics: Motor, encoder, and electronics combined into a single compact package for decentralized automation systems.
- Stainless Steel Servo Motors for Hygienic Applications: Durable, easy-to-clean stainless steel servo motor portfolio designed for washdown and hygienic environments.


Application examples and demonstrations will include:


- Wheel drive utilizing KMF062 with integrated gearbox
- Wheel drive utilizing KMF072 with integrated gearbox, integrated electronics, and brake
- Prototype utilizing a strain wave gearbox
- SIM racing chair prototype powered by a KinetiMax™ HPD motor
- 360° LED status ring on HeiTronX HTB and HTS product lines


The frameless motor demonstrations showcase design flexibility, reduced packaging size, and optimized performance in robotic and mobility applications, while the LED status ring provides visual operating feedback and simplified troubleshooting.


“SPS is an important opportunity to present the new KinetiMax™ Housed HPD Series alongside our wider range of motion technologies,” said Helmut Pirthauer, Vice President and Group President at Allient. “We welcome visitors to our booth to see these technologies in person and discuss how they can support their applications.”


To schedule a meeting with Allient at the event, visit[here](https://allient.com/contact-us/) .


**ABOUT ALLIENT INC.**


Allient (Nasdaq: ALNT) is a global engineering and manufacturing enterprise that develops solutions to drive the future of market-moving industries, including medical, life sciences, aerospace and defense, industrial automation, robotics, semi-conductor, transportation, agriculture, construction, and facility infrastructure. A family of globally responsible companies, Allient takes a One-Team approach to “Connect What Matters” and provides the most robust, reliable, and high-value products and systems by utilizing its core Motion, Controls, and Power technologies and platforms.


Headquartered in Buffalo, N.Y., Allient employs more than 2,500 team members around the world.
